scope: local offline reserve builder executable provenance and binary override refusal; no runtime admission

preFixRegression.observed: A harmless unselected executable wrote its invocation marker before the build refused.

checks: A supplied executable path, the special default-looking override and an empty override all refuse before invocation or output creation.
Actual Node and installed native bundler byte counts and hashes are recorded without private executable paths. Tests independently compare those hashes with selected local files.
Both executable fingerprints and resolved paths are rechecked after two matching builds. The native package version must match the selected bundler API.
The native package must resolve from the installed dependency graph; a missing package cannot use the bundler downloader fallback.

limitations: These are observed build-time fingerprints, not independently trusted allowlist entries, executable-origin attestations or runtime admission.
Matching bytes before and after a build do not prove continuous process identity or eliminate replacement races. Node dynamic libraries and host integrity remain outside this review.
Builtin-only imports remain capable of network access; full dependency/dynamic-resolution review and fresh compiler/replay integration remain open.
Local build support is restricted to little-endian Linux/macOS x64/arm64; local evidence does not claim every supported host was exercised.
Previously retained artifacts, manifests and failed attempts remain unchanged. No canonical runtime, ledger, configuration or alert was changed.
